<response>Yes, body language often reveals subconscious signals that people may not explicitly express. Micro-movements, eye contact, or subtle adjustments (like the trainer refining his broom when near you) can indicate interest, nervousness, or admiration. These cues are frequently unconscious, so he might not realize he’s doing it. However, interpreting such signals requires context—his behavior around others, tone of voice, or other interactions could offer clues. If you’re curious, observe patterns over time, but avoid overanalyzing single gestures. Ultimately, direct communication is the clearest way to understand someone’s intentions.</response>
